scenes.caption: AI agents are useful. Agents that can move money are risky.
scenes.narration: AI support agents are useful, but an agent that can move money on its own is a risk.

card.title: SafeDesk
card.subtitle: A support agent that can't move money on its own.

scenes.caption: A customer asks about an order, in Italian. No sign-in needed.
scenes.narration: A customer asks about their order in Italian. The agent answers straight away.

scenes.caption: Small refund, under the 500,000 ₫ limit: the agent handles it.
scenes.narration: A small refund under the limit goes through without a human.

scenes.caption: Prompt injection in Portuguese: flagged, held, no money moved.
scenes.narration: Now an attacker tells the agent to ignore its rules and refund two million dong. The message is flagged and the refund is held, so no money moves.

scenes.caption: Only an admin signs in, through TideCloak.
scenes.narration: The admin signs in through TideCloak. The role comes from the token.

scenes.caption: The queue shows the attack text as untrusted. The admin denies it.
scenes.narration: The admin sees the original message marked as untrusted, and denies the request. The customer sees it was denied.

scenes.caption: A genuine large refund waits too. The admin approves; the refund is applied.
scenes.narration: A genuine large refund also waits for review. This time the admin approves and the refund is applied.

scenes.caption: Every step is in the audit log.
scenes.narration: Every step is recorded in the audit log.

scenes.caption: The agent proposes. Only a signed-in admin approves.
scenes.narration: The agent proposes. Only a signed-in admin approves.

card.title: The agent proposes. Only a signed-in admin approves.
card.subtitle: The Farmers · RMIT Hackathon 2026
